conversion: Semantic dimensions/translations remain in mm. OBJ coordinates divide mm by 1 to use declared mm; no frame conversion.
known_losses: OBJ does not retain semantic operation history or enforce dimensions/constraints; configure importer units explicitly
Material identifiers are retained in source only; no engineering material properties, textures or measured appearance are exported
SVG is an illustrative projection of the same faceted geometry with no depth/collision analysis; overlapping primitives may occlude incorrectly
Cylinders are inscribed regular polygons with planar side facets and two ngon caps; no smooth surface or smooth normals. Odd side counts need not span the nominal diameter on each axis
No Boolean CSG, assemblies, topology/manifold qualification or tolerance solving in this box/cylinder renderer
Human brief constraints and review criteria are recorded, not automatically proven
No Blender qualification, engineering fitness, fabrication readiness, machine authority or client acceptance
